title: startup-krediter programs
description: One record per funding, compute, credit or accelerator program. Eligibility is data: a list of rules the matcher evaluates against a profile.

country.description: ISO-2 country, EU for EU plus EEA plus Horizon-associated countries, or global.

status_url.description: The page to fetch before quoting a date, an amount, or whether a round is open.

reference.description: Reference file and anchor with the prose entry for this program.

last_verified.description: The date the status page was actually read. Records older than 90 days are flagged stale.

availability.description: Whether applications were being accepted on last_verified. Closed doors rank last and carry a glyph line that points at the status page.

apply_requirements.description: Things the founder must have, prepare or do to get through the application that are not eligibility rules: login method, attachments, co-financing, language, account, partner, interview, decision time. Shown as a checklist before the founder goes to the site.

unclear.description: What the program's pages do not say or say inconsistently, phrased so the founder knows what to ask and whom.

home_country.description: For a door open to several countries but run and paid by one (a Vinnova call that admits foreign startups): the funder's country. Doors whose home_country is not the founder's rank after domestic doors instead of first.

group.description: Doors in the same group with the same status and open questions collapse into one answer with the siblings listed, so three EuroHPC tiers read as one choice.

rule.description: The label and the question the founder sees are generated from field, op and value in the founder's language (scripts/i18n.py), so the glyph can never claim more than the rule checks.

group.description: Met if any member is met. Failed only when every member is known and failed. Otherwise unknown. The label is the members' labels joined with 'or'.
